verdicts.evidence: Commit f98ae9dee exposes `flagged` from useTrustedSafesModal and removes the second useFlaggedSimilarAddresses call from ManageTrustedSafesContent.tsx. The author replied "fixed" to the bot review.

The trusted set is still built only from pinned (added) safes: at f5f5 it came from allAdded, and in HEAD's useOnboardingSafes.ts it comes from `safe.isPinned`, which useAllSafes.ts:52 derives from added safes only. No commit unions in undeployed safes, and the author's blanket "fixed" does not specifically address this point.
In the useOnboardingSafes.ts:34 thread, the author explained that combinedAddresses feeds useSimilarityClusters, which already dedupes, so no unique pass is needed there.
The author replied "Yes... fixed", and commit 9da16af3e rewrites useOnboardingSafes to use useAllSafes and `isPinned`.
Commit f98ae9dee has useSimilarityClusters explicitly stamp a shared groupId on an in-list impostor and its anchor, so grouping no longer depends on the configs matching. It also adds tests for this.

At f5f5, both useTrustedSafesModal and useManageNestedSafes.ts:75 defined the useCallback wrapper. Commit 94e49306e folds isAddressFlagged into useSimilarityClusters' return, as the author described in the thread.
Commit f98ae9dee removes the separate loop over imitated addresses and adds a guard so the anchor work only runs when anchorAnnotations.size > 0 (useSimilarityClusters.ts).
Commit f98ae9dee renames useListSimilarities to useAnchorListMatches, the name the bot suggested.

The author replied "rewrite it to more human readable style", and commit 695d0ba2a refactors the function (now detectIntraListClusters) with clearer names such as putInSameCluster, bucketByKey and membersByLeader.
